ov: The biggest of the striped cats and a solitary ambush hunter of forests, from Indian mangroves to snowy Russian taiga. It now occupies less than a tenth of its historical range.

why.ac: Mostly active from dusk into the night.
why.dg: Most attacks are defensive, but some tigers hunt people: the Champawat Tiger caused over 430 deaths.

rg: Scattered populations in India and the rest of South Asia, Southeast Asia, Sumatra, north-east China and the Russian Far East. India has the most tiger habitat.
df: Mainly large hoofed animals such as deer and wild pigs, plus buffalo and gaur where they occur.
fx: A powerful swimmer that crosses wide rivers and often soaks in water on hot days.
